title: Omnivore Weight Loss - 3 Meals
calorie_strategy: calculate TDEE/BMR then adjust gently; no aggressive deficit for pregnancy, children or medical users
macro_strategy: protein, carbohydrates and fats balanced around training/recovery; personalize by body size, goal, activity and medical review
hydration_strategy: water first; add electrolytes for long heat/sweat sessions where suitable
foods_to_prioritize: vegetables; fruit; legumes; whole grains where tolerated; lean proteins or diet-appropriate alternatives; healthy fats; calcium/iron/B12 sources where relevant
foods_to_limit: ultra-processed foods; excessive added sugar; alcohol; stimulant-heavy drinks; foods blocked by allergy/medical/religious preference
protein_guidance: Use body-weight/goal-based protein targets only after profile setup; prioritize whole foods first.
recovery_food_notes: After hard training, pair carbohydrate + protein + fluids; for vegan/vegetarian, combine legumes/grains/soy/nuts/seeds and check B12/iron/calcium planning.
risk_notes: Pregnancy, baby, child, diabetes, kidney disease, eating disorders, allergies and medication interactions require qualified review. Carnivore/very restrictive diets need extra review for fiber/micronutrients.
data_source_hint: Use USDA FoodData Central for nutrient values; use Open Food Facts for packaged barcode data with license/attribution handling.

macro_strategy: protein, carbohydrates and fats balanced around training/recovery; personalize by body size, goal, activity and medical review
hydration_strategy: water first; add electrolytes for long heat/sweat sessions where suitable
foods_to_prioritize: vegetables; fruit; legumes; whole grains where tolerated; lean proteins or diet-appropriate alternatives; healthy fats; calcium/iron/B12 sources where relevant
foods_to_limit: ultra-processed foods; excessive added sugar; alcohol; stimulant-heavy drinks; foods blocked by allergy/medical/religious preference
protein_guidance: Use body-weight/goal-based protein targets only after profile setup; prioritize whole foods first.
recovery_food_notes: After hard training, pair carbohydrate + protein + fluids; for vegan/vegetarian, combine legumes/grains/soy/nuts/seeds and check B12/iron/calcium planning.
risk_notes: Pregnancy, baby, child, diabetes, kidney disease, eating disorders, allergies and medication interactions require qualified review. Carnivore/very restrictive diets need extra review for fiber/micronutrients.
